title: Semi-Annual Runway/Taxiway Photometric Measurement

footer.manualLine: Visual Aid and Electrical System Maintenance Manual.

items.text: Previous 6-month serviceability trend reviewed; areas of concern identified
In-field measurements performed for ALL runway edge lights (or as far as practicable)
In-field measurements performed for ALL threshold lights
In-field measurements performed for ALL runway end lights
Measurement data recorded for each fixture (attach measurement records)
All lights below 50% of BCAR-14 specification identified (unserviceable per BCAR-139.311)
All lights below 70% of specification identified for scheduled maintenance
No two adjacent lights simultaneously below 50% specification
Fixture physical condition inspected: ground elevation, base torque, corrosion
Semi-Annual Photometric Report prepared and submitted to Operations Manager

validationRules: Every item marked NOSAT requires non-empty remarks before submission.
notes: Item codes C04-01.. are SYNTHETIC. The approved form lists items without identifiers; codes exist only so responses, incidents and audit records can reference a row, and must never be printed on the exported form.
Generated by scripts/vaes-extract.mjs from the approved base PDF. Re-run it rather than hand-editing; every coordinate is a measured glyph position.
Document control values are pre-printed constants on the approved form — not inputs, and never overlaid.
